summary: Auddia Inc. (Nasdaq: AUUD), as target in a February 17, 2026 merger with McCarthy Finney/Holdco and Thramann Holdings, filed an 8-K after cancelling its October 7, 2026 special meeting. Although ~89% of votes cast favored the business combination proposal, Delaware law requires majority approval of all outstanding shares, so the vote failed. Auddia will reschedule with a new record date. No price, premium, or close date was disclosed in the excerpt. Watch whether a lower approval threshold or share issuance is pursued, and the risk of further adjournments.
